triggerReason: The roadmap's remaining science program: the third campaign (safety-floor withdrawal grid) and the multi-season study were still open after v4.10.0.
action: Preregister and run the safety-floor grid campaign across the full constitutional floor range, implement the multi-season study with archive chaining, and project both into the Human Observatory.
outcome: safety-floor-grid-v1 published 3/5: the v2 withdrawal-rate finding does not replicate when the floor is isolated (rates 0.0828/0.0795/0.0766/0.0822, non-monotonic), needs remain saturated at ceiling, bargain throughput stays neutral within ±2%, and the floor alone raises pooled RALR by up to +1.7 pp (min 0.7672, baseline 0.7503) revealing an interaction with reserve and window. The multi-season study passed: two seeds x two consecutive seasons x 90 Turns, every archive verified, the fingerprint chain continuous, pooled RALR 0.7217 (503/697), and the production rollover explicitly not executed. All roadmap items are now implemented; the next science candidates (factorial interaction campaign, material-calibration probe) are uncommitted proposals.
